import parse

# Check fixed fields behavior with trailing newline
print('Fixed fields tests...')

r = parse.parse('{0}', 'value\n')
print('  {0} with \"value\\\\n\":', r)

r2 = parse.parse('{0:d}', '42\n')
print('  {0:d} with \"42\\\\n\":', r2)

# Multiple fixed fields  
r3 = parse.parse('{0}:{1}', 'foo:bar\n')
print('  {0}:{1} with \"foo:bar\\\\n\":', r3)
"
